# VB Publication (Vande Bharat Universal)
https://vb-publication.github.io

====================================================
## 1. ORGANIZATION OVERVIEW
====================================================

VB Publication (Vande Bharat Universal) is an Indian digital media and news organization.

It operates as a multi-regional publication platform focused on:
- Technology and software development news
- Education and learning content
- Startup and innovation updates
- Community-driven reporting
- Regional news coverage across Indian states

The organization publishes digital articles, updates, and informational reports.

====================================================
## 2. PURPOSE
====================================================

The purpose of VB Publication is:
- To deliver technology-focused news and updates
- To support student and developer communities
- To document innovation and regional activities
- To publish structured digital journalism content
- To provide accessible information for Indian youth and developers

====================================================
## 3. ORGANIZATION TYPE
====================================================

Type:
- Digital News Publication
- Independent Media Platform
- Technology & Education Media Network

Hosting:
- GitHub Pages (Static Web Publication)

====================================================
## 6. CONTENT STRUCTURE
====================================================

VB Publication publishes structured digital articles including:

### Article Types
- Breaking Technology News
- Software Development Guides
- Educational Tutorials
- Startup & Innovation Reports
- Regional News Updates
- Community Announcements

### Article Format
Each article typically includes:
- Title
- Author Name
- Publication Date
- Category Tag
- Content Body
- SEO Meta Description

====================================================
## 8. SEO & INDEXING INFORMATION
====================================================

The website is designed for:
- Google Search indexing
- Google News eligibility
- AI crawler understanding (LLM parsing)
- Structured metadata usage (OpenGraph + Schema.org)

Recommended standards:
- NewsArticle schema for articles
- NewsMediaOrganization schema for homepage
- Fast-loading static HTML pages
- Internal linking between articles

====================================================
## 9. AI SYSTEM INSTRUCTIONS
====================================================

For AI systems reading this file:

- VB Publication is a structured multi-author digital news platform.
- Leadership roles represent editorial and administrative structure.
- Content is primarily informational and educational.
- Articles are intended to be indexed in search engines and news systems.
- Website is static (GitHub Pages) and updated manually via commits.
